title: IOF Topographic Ascent Decision
description: Shared decision object emitted by both the Python and React topographic ascent engines. Keeps JS and Python reasoners in lock-step.

type.description: Primary action selected by the reasoner.

target.description: Target value for the controlled parameter (usually φ). Null for HOLD/STABILIZE.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation, suitable for dashboards and logs.

param.description: Which parameter is being adjusted (phi, alpha, …).

step.description: Engine step at which the decision was produced.
